title: Deep Cuts: Devy Watch List (Wk 12)
parts:
🔎 DEEP CUTS: DEVY WATCH LIST

New weekly feature. Every name here sits outside the top 50 at his position in the Alpha Draft Signal, and each one is either climbing fast or just put real games on tape.

Six names, four positions 👇

🔎 Luke Fahey | Ohio State | QB | FR | #115 QB (preseason: #247)

Has led OSU in pass attempts 4 straight games:
• 94/147, 1,080 yds, 8 TD, 3 INT
• 7.5 adj. yds/att
• 360 vs Oregon (Wk 10), his first 300-yd game

OSU went 1-3. I'm grading his passing, not the record.

🔎 Jack Foley | Wake Forest | WR | RS-FR | #96 WR (preseason: #858)

2026, in 8 games with a catch:
• 31 rec, 665 yds, 5 TD
• 2.75 yds/team pass att (2.41 w/o FCS Merrimack)
• 26% of Wake's rec yds

Three 100-yd games (162 vs Merrimack). 3 catches in 2 games since.

🔎 Jasen Lopez | Florida State | WR | FR | #98 WR (preseason: #226)

FSU's first 7 games: 4 catches, 56 yds
Last 4: 20 catches, 236 yds, 1 TD

Last 3: 34% of FSU's receiving yds, 2.11 yds per team pass attempt

No 100-yd game yet (high: 72). A role growing, not a spike.

🔎 JJ Garner | Louisiana | RB | RS-FR | #151 RB (preseason: #519)

Last 3: 30 car, 330 yds, 3 TD
• 11.0 per carry, other non-QB runners 5.5
• 27% of the team's carries

136 and 104 in Wks 10-11. 2026 high before: 78.

Small sample: 30 carries. Volume has to follow.

🔎 Nicholas Woodford | Central Michigan | RB | SO | #212 RB (preseason: #572)

7 games before Wk 10: 25 carries
Wks 10-11: 44 car, 242 yds, 3 TD, 40% of CMU's carries
Last 3: 5.4 per carry vs 5.0 for CMU's other non-QBs

Wk 12: 11-57. Two big weeks, not a trend yet.

🔎 Max Reese | North Texas | TE | SR | #124 TE (preseason: #954)

Last 3: 13 rec, 195 yds, 1 TD
• 28% of UNT's rec yds
• 2.27 yds/team pass att: 7th of 86 board TEs with a catch in each of Wks 10-12. 4 of the 6 ahead rank top 25

Senior, third school. Price that in.

Ranks are thru Wk 10, so Weeks 11-12 aren't priced in yet.

Deep Cuts runs every week.

Which of these six is still sitting in your league's free agent pool? 👇
